description: A session started on a chosen Model (gpt-5.6-sol, not the config's gpt-5.6-terra) whose host also asks for the Model list. The Model rides on thread/start's `model`; the thread result names it, so session_init and token_usage carry it. list_models arrives before the thread exists and is held until it does, then goes out as model/list after the first turn/start (so the handshake's request ids never move); a second page (nextCursor) is fetched, and the pages together are one models_listed (id = the Model's `model` slug, which thread/start and thread/resume take). Codex reports no Model per request, so switch_model_live is false: no set_model, no model_changed. Synthesised from the codex app-server JSON schema generated by codex-cli 0.144.1 (`codex app-server generate-json-schema`), not captured from a live run: replace with a capture (see crates/codex-adapter/README.md).
